integrity_statement: Only the evaluated fourth-order directional lag theorem, not the stationary spatial factorization, is assessed as the contribution; no empirical measurements or independent review are claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive Brownian finger and backbone coefficients and Poisson complete origin resetting, continuous singular comb, and stationary law; no discrete-finger, partial-reset or heavy-tail generalization proved. General complete-reset renewal identities and the stationary spatial distribution are prior art. Literature priority remains qualified.
title: A covariance-invisible temporal arrow in a resetting Brownian comb
